caption:
Do you cook from a recipe or by eye? Tell us in the comments.

WE.LIFE recipes are broken into steps with ingredients, and cooking mode guides you through each one; adjust portions to the number of people and turn recipes into a weekly meal plan. No guessing what's next, just the next step.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#cookingtips #recipes #mealplan
